# The pledge total isn't your payout. Take-home is.

> Free calculator for Patreon creators: real monthly payout after platform and processing fees, and whether per-creation billing costs you more than monthly.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/patreon-fee-calculator/)
- [Does per-creation billing cost more in fees?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/patreon-fee-calculator/does-per-creation-billing-cost-more-in-fees.html)
- [Patreon fee calculator vs. doing the payout math yourself](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/patreon-fee-calculator/vs-doing-the-math-yourself.html)
